title: lathyrus brachypterus var. haussknechtii
intro: Lathyrus brachypterus var. haussknechtii, commonly known as Haussknecht's pea, is a type of vetch that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus brachypterus var. haussknechtii include its potential use as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
